update-or-new-station.title: Update or new station?
update-or-new-station.description: Is this an update to an existing station or an entirely new station?

previous-site-log.title: Previous site log
previous-site-log.description: If this is an update to an existing station, please attach the previous site log if you have access

reason-for-update.title: Reason for update
reason-for-update.description: If this is an update to an existing station, please provide a brief (1-3 sentences) explaining why this update occurred.

funding-source.title: Funding source
funding-source.description: If known, please provide the funding source

funding-grant.title: Funding grant
funding-grant.description: If known, please provide the grant

creator_name.title: Creator Name
creator_name.description: Name of the person or organization that collected the data.   Follow the guidance described in the creator_type attribute for how to populate this field depending on whether a person, institution, group, or position.

creator_address.title: Creator address
creator_address.description: Street address of the person or organization that collected the data.

creator_city.title: Creator city
creator_city.description: City of the person or organization that collected the data.

creator_postalcode.title: Creator postal code
creator_postalcode.description: The postal code of the person or organization that collected the data.

creator_country.title: Creator country
creator_country.description: Country of the person or organization that operates a platform or network, which collected the observation data.

creator_email.title: Creator email
creator_email.description: Email address of the person or institution that collected the data.

creator_institution.title: Creator institution
creator_institution.description: Institution that collected the data. This should be specified even if it matches the value of publisher_institution, institution or if creator_type is institution.

creator_institution_url.title: Creator institution url
creator_institution_url.description: URL for the institution that collected the data. For clarity, it is recommended that this field is specified even if the creator_type is institution and a creator_url is provided.

creator_phone.title: Creator phone
creator_phone.description: The phone number of the person or group that collected the data.   Example:creator_phone = "(240) 533-9444" creator_phone = "+1-240-533-9444"

creator_sector.title: Creator sector
creator_sector.description: IOOS classifier that best describes the platform (network) operator’s societal sector.   Example:creator_sector = "academic"

creator_state.title: Creator state
creator_state.description: State of the person or organization that collected the data.

creator_type.title: Creator type
creator_type.description: Specifies type of creator with one of the following: ‘person’, ‘group’, ‘institution’, or ‘position’. If this attribute is not specified, the creator is assumed to be a person.

creator_url.title: Creator url
creator_url.description: URL of the person or organization that collected the data.

contributor_role:custodian.title: Custodian name
contributor_role:custodian.description: The name of any individuals or institutions that contributed to the creation of this data. Custodian is party that accepts accountability and responsibility for the data, and ensures appropriate care and maintenance of the resource

data-provider.title: Data provider
data-provider.description: Name of data provider, such as ***REMOVED***Hohonu***REMOVED*** or other company. Not a link

data-provider---additional.title: Data provider - additional
data-provider---additional.description: Link to outside data sources, such as company***REMOVED***s website (ex. Hohonu)

additional-information.title: Additional information
additional-information.description: Add link to collocated dataset (ERDDAP link, portal link, if available)

contributor_role:processor.title: Data Processor
contributor_role:processor.description: Party that has processed the data in a manner such that the resource has been modified

contributor_role:funder.title: Funder
contributor_role:funder.description: Party providing monetary support for the resource

state.title: State
state.description: State in which the asset is located

wmo_platform_code.title: CO-OPS ID
wmo_platform_code.description: Provided by CO-OPS. Only provide if known/established. Do not create.

is-this-a-co-ops-station.title: Is this a CO-OPS Station? (yes/no)
is-this-a-co-ops-station.description: Filterable question to determine type of station being installed.

water-body-setting.title: Water body setting
water-body-setting.description: Ex: Next to coast, Lake coastline, etc

approximate-position.title: Approximate position
approximate-position.description: Ex: On building mounted on scaffolding

horizontal-datum-projection-.title: Horizontal datum projection
horizontal-datum-projection-.description: Horizontal datum for the lat/lon (eg: NAD83) / projection

mhhw-m.title: MHHW (m):
mhhw-m.description: Offset between station datum and MHHW in meters

mhw-m.title: MHW (m):
mhw-m.description: Offset between station datum and MHW in meters

dtl-m.title: DTL (m):
dtl-m.description: The arithmetic mean of mean higher high water and mean lower low water.

mtl-m.title: MTL (m):
mtl-m.description: The arithmetic mean of mean high water and mean low water.

msl-m.title: MSL (m):
msl-m.description: The arithmetic mean of hourly heights observed over the National Tidal Datum Epoch. Shorter series are specified in the name; e.g. monthly mean sea level and yearly mean sea level.

mlw-m.title: MLW (m):
mlw-m.description: Offset between station datum and MLW in meters.

mllw-m.title: MLLW (m):
mllw-m.description: Offset between station datum and MLLW in meters

gt-m.title: GT (m)
gt-m.description: The difference in height between mean higher high water and mean lower low water.

mn-m.title: MN (m)
mn-m.description: The difference in height between mean high water and mean low water.

dhq-m.title: DHQ (m)
dhq-m.description: One-half the average difference between the two high waters of each tidal day observed over the National Tidal Datum Epoch. It is obtained by subtracting the mean of all the high waters from the mean of the higher high waters.

dlq-m.title: DLQ (m)
dlq-m.description: One-half the average difference between the two low waters of each tidal day observed over the National Tidal Datum Epoch. It is obtained by subtracting the mean of the lower low waters from the mean of all the low waters.

hwi-hr.title: HWI (hr)
hwi-hr.description: The average interval (in hours) between the moon***REMOVED***s transit over the Greenwich meridian and the following high water at a location.

lwi-hr.title: LWI (hr)
lwi-hr.description: The average interval (in hours) between the moon***REMOVED***s transit over the Greenwich meridian and the following low water at a location.

benchmarks-photo.title: Photo of the two surveyed benchmark***REMOVED***s face stamping
benchmarks-photo.description: Suggested: 4 specific views are face (up close showing the stamping of the mark), setting (generally taken from chest height) and 2 directional photos. Ideally, you***REMOVED***d want all 4 directions to help find the mark on future visits and/or to help validate suitability for things such as GPS/GNSS (things that could obstruct a signal: tree, fence, building...etc)

license.title: Disclaimer
license.description: NOAA specific req for NWS ingestion. specify uncertainty and limitations of use

dissemination-flag.title: Dissemination flag
dissemination-flag.description: NOAA specific req for NWS ingestion

prior-wmo-id.title: If CO-OPS, was there a prior location for this CO-OPs station?

prior-wmo-coordinates.title: If yes to previous question, what is lat/long in DD?
prior-wmo-coordinates.description: Work to be done pre- or post-field work

contributor_role:distributor.title: Brand of instrument/sensor/provider
contributor_role:distributor.description: Brand of the overall device that houses single or multiple instruments/components. For example, ***REMOVED***Hohonu***REMOVED*** is the brand of a sensor that can contain multiple instruments.

instrument-brand.title: Instrument brand
instrument-brand.description: Instrument is defined as the overall physical device that houses multiple sensors and components. For example, a Hohonu instrument includes individual WL sensor and a separate telecommunication component.

instrument.title: Instrument
instrument.description: Global, vocabulary-constrained attribute indicating the name of the contributing instrument(s) or sensor(s) used to create this dataset. Indicate controlled vocabulary used in the instrument_vocabulary attribute. Separate multiple instruments using commas.

instrument_variable:component.title: Instrument component
instrument_variable:component.description: The value of a component applies to the like-named field in the IOOS SOS Asset Identifier URN; it is used to identify individual, distinct components, or sub-assets (for example, two different sensor types), on a single platform. The :component is mapped to the Asset Identifier as follows:   Asset Identifier = urn:ioos:asset_type:authority:label[:component][:discriminant][#functional_parameters]  See examples below.

instrument_variable:make_model.title: Instrument make/model
instrument_variable:make_model.description: The make and model of the instrument.

is-real-time.title: Real time?
is-real-time.description: Yes/No if the instrument reports in real time

marker-ngs-pid.title: Marker NGS PID
marker-ngs-pid.description: NGS = National Geodetic Survey; PID = Permanent Identifier Can be completed pre-field work during recon.
enum: Not available - this opens up the VM# field

marker-co-ops-vm.title: Marker CO-OPS VM#
marker-co-ops-vm.description: Only if PID is not available

ortho-height-navd88-m.title: Ortho height (NAVD88 m)
ortho-height-navd88-m.description: Height of the sensor in NAVD88

ellipsoidal-height-m.title: Ellipsoidal height (m)
ellipsoidal-height-m.description: Height of the sensor in ellipsoidal height (m)
